description: Split the monolithic MohistCliCommands.Issue.cs (Complexity 223 / 2268L) into per-subcommand-cluster partial files, collapsing the 24x output-mode and 31x project-id validation idioms into shared helpers, with all CLI observable behavior preserved bit-for-bit.

tasks.title: Establish cross-cutting helpers and consolidate repeated idioms
tasks.spec: specs/cli-module-structure/spec.md#重复 CLI 惯法收拢为共享 helper
tasks.description: Convert `IssueCommands` to `internal static partial class` (still a single file) and add the two cross-cutting shared helpers to the core region: `ValidateOutput(api, output)` (body copied verbatim from `EpicCommands.ValidateOutput`) and `ResolveProjectId(api, project, projectId)` (a pure delegation wrapper over `api.ResolveProjectIdAsync` returning `(ProjectId, Exit)`). Rewrite all 24 inline output-mode validation idioms to call `ValidateOutput` and all 31 inline project-id resolution idioms to call `ResolveProjectId`. Flip the two uncalled `internal` helpers `ParseLabelsFromIssue` and `PrintCreateGuidance` back to `private` (D5). This is the foundation for the partial carve-out and the behavior-adjacent step, isolated for review per the design Migration Plan step 1+2.
acceptanceCriteria: `IssueCommands` is declared `internal static partial class IssueCommands` and the whole class still compiles as a single file.

`ValidateOutput(MohistCliApi api, string? output)` exists in the core region with the `(string Mode, int Exit)` return shape byte-for-byte matching `EpicCommands.ValidateOutput` (MohistCliCommands.Epic.cs:38).

`ResolveProjectId(MohistCliApi api, string? project, string? projectId)` exists in the core region returning `Task<(string ProjectId, int Exit)>`, delegating purely to `api.ResolveProjectIdAsync` with no added I/O.
No handler inlines `MohistCliApi.ValidateOutputMode` unpack logic (the `is Invalid` → `api.Error.WriteLine` → `return 1` → cast `Valid` block); all 24 sites call `ValidateOutput`.
No handler inlines the `await api.ResolveProjectIdAsync(...)` + `if (null) return 1;` block; all 31 sites call `ResolveProjectId`.
`ParseLabelsFromIssue` and `PrintCreateGuidance` are `private`; repo-wide grep finds no external callers (compile gate proves it).
`dotnet build packages/cli/Mohist.Cli/Mohist.Cli.csproj` succeeds with TreatWarningsAsErrors (C# lint gate).
The full CLI issue spec suite passes unchanged: `dotnet test packages/cli --filter 'FullyQualifiedName~CliIssue'`.
No observable CLI behavior change: command names/aliases, flag names/shapes, output formats, and exit codes identical to pre-refactor (verified by the passing specs).
tasks.output: Modified `packages/cli/Mohist.Cli/MohistCliCommands.Issue.cs` — class now `static partial` with `ValidateOutput`/`ResolveProjectId` helpers and all 24+31 inline idioms rewritten; `ParseLabelsFromIssue`/`PrintCreateGuidance` set to `private`.
tasks.notes: Per design D3/D4, the helper bodies are verbatim/pure-delegation so behavior is preserved. The option reads (`ctx.GetValue(projectOpt)` etc.) stay at each call site per D4 — only the resolve+null-check half collapses. This is the largest behavior-adjacent step and must land before any partial carve.

This is a verbatim move; private members of the same partial class remain accessible, so call sites compile unchanged. Verify with the CRUD-related specs.

None of the above CRUD methods remain in the core `MohistCliCommands.Issue.cs` partial.
Call sites to shared helpers (`ValidateOutput`, `ResolveProjectId`, `NumberArg`, `ProjectIssuesPath`, `IsOptionProvided`) resolve across the partial boundary with no visibility widening.

tasks.notes: Largest cluster (~500L). `PrintCreateGuidance` moves here because it is called only from `BuildCreate`; `ParseLabelsFromIssue` belongs to the update/create label flow — both per design D1 cluster-ownership rule.

tasks.title: Carve Workflow config cluster into Issue.Workflow.cs + Issue.WorkflowConfigSet.cs partials

acceptanceCriteria: `packages/cli/Mohist.Cli/MohistCliCommands.Issue.Workflow.cs` exists containing `BuildWorkflow`, `BuildWorkflowConfig`, `BuildWorkflowConfigGet`, `PrintWorkflowProfileAsync`, `BuildWorkflowConfigPreview`, and `BuildWorkflowConfigClear`.

`dotnet test packages/cli --filter 'FullyQualifiedName~CliIssueWorkflowConfigSpecs|FullyQualifiedName~CliIssueWorkflowProfileSpecs|FullyQualifiedName~CliIssueExecutionConfigFlagsSpecs'` passes — guarding workflow config get/preview/clear/set, the `--stage-models`/`--stage-model-variants` `@file` expansion, PATCH semantics, and execution config flags bit-for-bit.

tasks.title: Verify global acceptance: core-partial contents, complexity ranking, full suite
tasks.spec: specs/cli-module-structure/spec.md#Issue 命令按子命令簇 partial 拆分
tasks.description: Final review gate confirming the refactor's global invariants that can only be checked once every cluster partial exists. Audit the core partial contents, run the complete issue spec suite, and measure per-file scc complexity to confirm no Issue.* file sits in the cli package top five. This corresponds to design Migration Plan step 4.
acceptanceCriteria: The core `MohistCliCommands.Issue.cs` partial contains only `Build()` and the shared helpers (`NumberArg`, `ProjectIssuesPath`, `IssueTemplatesPath`, `IsOptionProvided`, `ValidateOutput`, `ResolveProjectId`) — no concrete subcommand build/handler methods (spec 'core partial only Build + helpers' scenario).

`scc packages/cli/Mohist.Cli/ --sort complexity` shows no `Issue.*` file in the top five; the core partial complexity is far below the pre-refactor 2268L/Complexity-223 monolith (spec '脱离 cli 包复杂度前列' scenario).
No output-mode or project-id idiom is inlined in any cluster partial — all delegate to the shared helpers (spec '簇内不得内联重复惯法' scenario).
`dotnet build packages/cli/Mohist.Cli/Mohist.Cli.csproj` succeeds with TreatWarningsAsErrors.

The full CLI issue spec suite passes: `dotnet test packages/cli --filter 'FullyQualifiedName~CliIssue'` (all of CliIssueCommandSpecs, CliIssueWorkflowConfigSpecs, CliIssueSessionSpecs, CliIssueLabelSpecs, CliIssueTemplateCommandSpecs, CliIssueUpdatePatchBodySpecs, CliIssuePrereqSpecs, CliIssueCommentAndFeedbackSpecs, CliIssueRerunFromStageSpecs, CliIssueRejectAndStopSpecs, CliIssueExecutionConfigFlagsSpecs, CliIssueWorkflowProfileSpecs).
`IssueCommands.Build()` retains its pre-refactor public shape; `Program.cs`/callers are unaffected.
tasks.output: Verification report: core-partial member audit, scc complexity ranking, full issue spec suite green, confirming all issue #317 acceptance criteria.
tasks.notes: Rollback is simply reverting the PR — no state migration and `IssueCommands.Build()`'s public shape is unchanged. This is a REVIEW (acceptance gate), not a standalone test-writing task; it runs the existing guardian specs and the scc ranking check that are only meaningful after all partials are carved.
